blocks.text: Every detail behind Ballet Manila’s staging of “The Nutcracker” tells a story long before the first notes of music play. Intricate set pieces take shape in the wings. Hand-crafted costumes fill the dressing rooms. Furthermore, dancers push their physical limits to transform strict classical form into raw, unfiltered heart. Bringing Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s 1892 holiday classic The Nutcracker to life is far more than an annual ritual for this creative team. It serves as an authentic testament to the emotional depth and world-class mastery of Filipino artists who have time and again made adaptations of this original Alexander Dumas tale an […]...
